lastCompletedStory.title: Codify the CAM Runtime brand palette as named design tokens

nextStoryContext: src/design/tokens.ts now exports `brandGreens` (firGreen #10C66F, forestGreen #003333, aeroGreen #CAFFE3, white #FFFFFF) and `brandNeutrals` (ink #1F1F1F, secondaryText #6F6F6F, secondaryTextOnDark #9C9C9C, surface #EDECF0, line #E3E3E5), kept fully separate from the existing chrome `palette` export (accent/warning/destructive/muted unchanged, #4EBE7D still the chrome accent). Subagent figure-only colors (Blue Lotus/Lemon/Sun Yellow/Salmon) are intentionally absent from this module by name-only comment; do not add their hex values here — CONTEXT.md brand terms are their canonical home. src/ui/Splash.tsx was NOT touched (CAM-329 owns wiring the Fir Green splash accent and the uppercase wordmark rewrite; it should import `brandGreens.firGreen` from src/design/tokens.ts rather than inlining the hex). The README brand work (CAM-331) should likewise import from `brandGreens`/`brandNeutrals` instead of inlining hexes. src/design/tokens.ts's file-size budget ceiling was raised 72->109 in scripts/file-size-budget.json (_ref updated) to cover the new exports; a future story adding more tokens to this file should raise the ceiling again rather than reuse headroom that doesn't exist.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed Ink's <Text color> accepts raw hex strings directly via chalk under the hood; tokens.ts keeps raw hex string values, as const, no ink/chalk import, matching the existing palette shape.
